Grace is reading a book about music. There are always many people at the camping site. Grace usually has bread for breakfast. Also, the soup is too hot.
Grace and Eva had great fun there. Both of them like bread and water. Grace learned a lot about music. What's more, water is our most important resource.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the green hill by bike. Grace hopes to visit London one day. Last Thursday, Grace and Eva went to the green hill. In fact, the wheat turns gold in early summer.
Life is full of small surprises. Eva's birthday is in April. Eva is interested in reading.
